_README: canonical_spec_opdiff.json -- the FROZEN definition of 'canonical' for the
opdiff task, and it is frozen NOWHERE YET. Every enforced field and every
architecture_variants value below is null, which is a DECISION and not an
oversight: the opdiff study is new, its protocol has not been frozen from
measurement, and the Gate 0 guard (more/run_context.py:assert_not_silent_proxy)
REFUSES an opdiff run that claims 'canonical_opdiff_b' while any field is
null. The complaint it produces names the file and the fields, which is the
intended direction of failure.
WHY A THIRD FILE rather than a `task` block inside canonical_spec.json:
canonical_spec.json is the definition the published arithmetic study is
quoted against, and the guard is not its only reader -- export_results.py
reads enforced_fields.dataset_version and .train_split_version, and the
test_phase6_provenance.py / test_phase6_seeding.py gates parse the file
directly and assert on its shape (run_name_template, seed_set). Restructuring
it to hold three tasks would put all of those on the same commit as a new
task's first experiment, for no scientific gain. T-L1.3 set the precedent with
canonical_spec_language.json; T-OD.3 follows it.
SAME CONTRACT as the other two. A run may declare
logging.experiment_group == 'canonical_opdiff_b' only if:
* every field in enforced_fields is non-null AND equals the run's value;
* every field in the block for its architecture is non-null AND equals;
* the seed is in seed_set;
* the run is not a subset run (subset_fraction == 1.0).
WHAT A RUN LOOKS LIKE UNTIL THE SPEC IS FROZEN. Every opdiff run is stamped
experiment_group = 'exploratory' (the default when --experiment_group is not
passed), which is the honest label: the numbers are real measurements of a
real model on a real dataset, but the PROTOCOL they were produced under has
not been ratified, so they may not head a table labelled canonical. The
pilot (T-OD.4/T-OD.5) is what produces the measurements the freeze is
made from.
HOW TO FREEZE A FIELD: replace the null with the measured value AND add its
one-line justification to frozen_by in the same edit, naming the task or gate
that produced it. A frozen number with no frozen_by entry is indistinguishable
from an inherited guess, which is the failure this file exists to prevent.
The fields that will move first, and why, are named in _FREEZE_PLAN.
_FREEZE_PLAN: THE FIELDS THAT WILL BE FROZEN FROM THE PILOT, in the order they can be:
epochs          from the measured epoch time and the agreed budget (T-OD.5).
NOT a convergence claim: the opdiff matrix is a fixed-budget
comparison, and the paper must say so.
batch_size      from measured VRAM headroom per arm on the 8 GB card, the
same way T-L7.0 froze 48 for language -- NOT 'as large as
fits', because the soft cliff above ~87% of VRAM costs
2x the epoch time.
routing_balance_weight, halting_weight
from the opdiff task-loss MAGNITUDE, which is a masked
cross-entropy over answer digits and therefore lives in a
different regime from both the arithmetic MSE and the
language 8192-way cross-entropy. The T-L7.1 lesson is that
a balance weight carried across tasks is an untested
assumption wearing a frozen number's authority.
dropout         opdiff rows are 16 SHORT packed examples, not documents,
so the language argument (underfitting on 100 M tokens)
does not transfer. Measure it.
dataset_version, train_split_version
the generator's content hash of the canonical generation
(opdiff-v2-<hash>). MEASURED, and stamped into the config
by config.py:stamp_opdiff_dataset_versions -- so the field
is a measurement of the bytes, never a declaration.
THE FIELDS THAT ARE DEFINITIONAL AND WILL NOT MOVE:
num_experts (7 for moe/more, 1 for mor -- the oracle partition's width),
attention (true -- a packed row of 16 examples needs its context),
tie_lm_head (true -- the output projection is the embedding transposed),
vocab_size (43 -- 18 fixed tokens + 25 operation tokens),
seq_len (304 -- 16 examples x 19 tokens),
routing_mode (top1_sparse) and router_noise (none),
family_cls_weight (0.0 -- the probe is detached, and opdiff rows DO carry a
whole-row group label, so a non-zero weight would be a live supervision
signal on the oracle partition),
halting_mode (pure_act -- opdiff has no depth curriculum at all; the
generator's nominal difficulty is a placeholder awaiting dense-baseline
calibration, and halting supervision is REFUSED on this task).

_note: Only the block whose name equals the run's `architecture` is consulted, so a
null in mor.ffn_mult blocks canonical MoR without blocking MoE or MoRE.
EVERY VALUE IS NULL, and that is the point of the file: the opdiff
protocol has not been ratified from measurement, so no arm may claim
canonical status. The expected shape of each block is recorded in the
_SHAPE_NOTE below, because 'null' and 'absent' are different states and a
later agent should know which fields this task will have.
`routing_persistence` will appear in the `more` block ONLY. The axis is
inert for moe (max_depth 1) and for mor (num_experts 1), and its absence
from those blocks is what keeps their config hashes free of a key that
`attention` is NOT here even though a reader might expect it per-arm -- it
is in enforced_fields, shared by all three. That placement is the claim:
_SHAPE_NOTE: moe : num_experts 7, max_depth 1, adaptive_halting false, ffn_mult 4,
ffn_mult 28 (7 experts x 4 -- the same budget rule arithmetic and
language use, applied to opdiff's seven groups), routing_balance_weight
